projects.title: Leading Together
projects.description: It started with a request for a slogan, it continued into a broad, beautiful, and fruitful collaboration because we created it together. PriBank now leads in many services as a bank built entirely with local capital.

data.content: PriBank, a new local bank in Kosovo founded in 2022, quickly established itself as a key player, dedicated to serving individual clients and focusing especially on small and medium enterprises.

Our journey with PriBank began when they sought a slogan, but what we delivered was a narrative, that grew into a comprehensive campaign. Using their name we developed a meaningful slogan: "PRIjmë bashkë." (We lead together).
But, we didn’t stop here, we developed a whole new tone of voice and communication by emphasizing the brand and building brand awareness in a very subtle and memorable way.

We created a heartwarming commercial for Pribank, centered around a family to emphasize the "Lead Together" slogan. Alongside this, we developed an animation showcasing the financial flexibility and support Pribank offers to help those in need, empowering families to build a better life.
